title: Finiteness and universal injectivity under base change and composition
statement: For morphisms of schemes, finite morphisms and universally injective morphisms are preserved by arbitrary base change and by composition. In particular, the base change of a finite radicial morphism is finite and radicial [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] [def-weil-radicial-morphism].
